correctness.rationale: All quantified finite posets and all prime-power fields are covered by explicit finite incidence convolution algebra. Orthogonal Boolean idempotents produce an invertible simultaneous conjugator; the normalizer of D inside U is trivial; the commutator entries impose exactly equality of diagonal bits along nonzero-support edges; field-coordinate independence gives the exact subgraph weight, Tutte identity, polynomial reconstruction, and cut inclusion-exclusion. Standalone finite exhaustive incidence-ring and graph enumerations agree in six cases; no finite experiment stands in for the proof.

value.rationale: The intersection spectrum of maximal commuting idempotent families is a natural semigroup/retraction compatibility invariant. An exact complete distribution on all finite-poset incidence algebras, Tutte completeness across finite fields, and a sharp leading minimum-edge-cut asymptotic go beyond routine single-idempotent counting, explain a structural graph/algebra connection, and provide a useful reconstruction boundary.
